data.name: calibration.tip.t000
data.value: Picker side to calibrate. Front and Rear store separate #4 references and collet offsets.

data.name: calibration.tip.t001
data.value: Collet number to calibrate. #4 is the Bottom Camera reference teaching position; #3/#2/#1 store offsets at pitch positions relative to #4.

data.name: calibration.tip.t002
data.value: Finder name requested on the Vision PC BottomInspection channel. It must match the collet detection name registered on the Vision PC.

data.name: calibration.tip.t003
data.value: T-axis angle used at collet calibration start and Bottom AutoFocus preparation. Default: 0 degrees; an angle such as 180 degrees may be selected for checking. Shared by all front/rear collets. Separate from recipe T teaching and T HOME origin application after calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t004
data.value: Angle tolerance for completing T-axis correction. Correction is OK when the absolute Theta reported by Vision is at or below this value.

data.name: calibration.tip.t005
data.value: Maximum T-axis correction attempts. The result is NG if Theta does not reach the tolerance within this count.

data.name: calibration.tip.t006
data.value: Multiplier for the opposite-direction move that brings the measured Theta to zero. A value of 1.0 corrects by the measured amount.

data.name: calibration.tip.t007
data.value: Distance tolerance for completing XY centering. Diagonal mode checks diagonal distance; Axis mode checks the absolute X and Y values separately.

data.name: calibration.tip.t008
data.value: Maximum XY centering attempts. The result is NG if the offset does not reach XY Tol within this count.

data.name: calibration.tip.t009
data.value: Multiplier applied to the Vision X correction. A value of 1.0 applies the measured amount.

data.name: calibration.tip.t010
data.value: Multiplier applied to the Vision Y correction. A value of 1.0 applies the measured amount.

data.name: calibration.tip.t011
data.value: Maximum XY fine correction while Z remains at inspection height. X/Y movements at or below this value use FineAlign; larger movements use Z/Y Avoid before the large move.

data.name: calibration.tip.t012
data.value: XY tolerance mode. Diagonal uses sqrt(X^2+Y^2); Axis checks that both |X| and |Y| are at or below the tolerance.

data.name: calibration.tip.t013
data.value: Minimum Vision detection score. Zero disables the score criterion. A positive value makes scores below the threshold NG.

data.name: calibration.tip.t014
data.value: Time to wait for the Vision PC Collet Finder response. No response within this time results in Timeout NG.

data.name: calibration.tip.t015
data.value: Dedicated XY/T/Z and initial safe-position movement speed for collet calibration. AutoFocus scanning uses the separate Vision Focus Cal speed setting.

data.name: calibration.tip.t016
data.value: Dedicated collet calibration movement acceleration. Existing axis interlocks remain in effect.

data.name: calibration.tip.t017
data.value: Dedicated collet calibration movement deceleration. Existing axis interlocks remain in effect.

data.name: calibration.tip.t018
data.value: Time to wait for collet calibration movement completion/InPosition.

data.name: calibration.tip.t019
data.value: Selected collet T-axis speed for the 360-degree COC START rotation. Shared by all collets; default: 30 deg/s.

data.name: calibration.tip.t020
data.value: When True, run Bottom AutoFocus and collet correction, detect/apply the COC rotation center, then run Side AutoFocus at 0 and 90 degrees. Side Focus requires the current picker's Bottom Die inspection result.

data.name: calibration.tip.t021
data.value: When True, run Side AutoFocus at 0/90 degrees after detecting the COC rotation center. When False, stop after COC and skip Side AutoFocus. Effective only when AutoFocus is True.

data.name: calibration.tip.t022
data.value: Die thickness added to Best Z measured after AutoFocus during Collet Cal. Saved inspection Z = measured Z + Die Thickness + Film Thickness + current Collet Type Offset.

data.name: calibration.tip.t023
data.value: Collet offset added to measured Z when recipe Collet Type is Rim. Down is negative and up is positive; enter a positive value to raise Z.

data.name: calibration.tip.t024
data.value: Collet offset added to measured Z when recipe Collet Type is Flat. Down is negative and up is positive; enter a positive value to raise Z.

data.name: calibration.tip.t025
data.value: Film thickness added to Best Z measured after AutoFocus during Collet Cal. Saved inspection Z = measured Z + Die Thickness + Film Thickness + current Collet Type Offset.

data.name: calibration.tip.t026
data.value: PlaceZ preparation speed for safe-position, X/T/Y alignment and scan-start moves. Flow searches use the separate Search speed settings.

data.name: calibration.tip.t027
data.value: Coarse downward PickerZ speed for the first Flow detection.

data.name: calibration.tip.t028
data.value: Coarse search acceleration for the first Flow detection.

data.name: calibration.tip.t029
data.value: Coarse search deceleration for the first Flow detection.

data.name: calibration.tip.t030
data.value: Fine search speed for detecting the final Flow position again after BackOff, Blow and Flow OFF confirmation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t031
data.value: PlaceZ preparation acceleration. Flow searches use the separate Search acceleration settings.

data.name: calibration.tip.t032
data.value: PlaceZ preparation deceleration. Flow searches use the separate Search deceleration settings.

data.name: calibration.tip.t033
data.value: Fine search acceleration for detecting Flow again after BackOff.

data.name: calibration.tip.t034
data.value: Fine search deceleration for detecting Flow again after BackOff.

data.name: calibration.tip.t035
data.value: Maximum time to wait for InPosition after each Z movement command. Exceeding it fails calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t036
data.value: Z position where PickerZ starts Flow searching. After safe-position alignment, the selected PickerZ first moves here.

data.name: calibration.tip.t037
data.value: Die thickness. Saved Place Z = Flow Z + Die Thickness + Film Thickness.

data.name: calibration.tip.t038
data.value: Film thickness. Saved Place Z = Flow Z + Die Thickness + Film Thickness.

data.name: calibration.tip.t039
data.value: Additional X displacement from the Output Process reference. Used as receiveTargetX in the place-position calculation relative to OutputVision.

data.name: calibration.tip.t040
data.value: Additional Y displacement from the Output Process reference. Used as receiveTargetY in the OutputStageY place-position calculation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t041
data.value: Start searching this distance above the current Place position, leaving clearance to avoid immediate contact with the target surface.

data.name: calibration.tip.t042
data.value: Maximum downward Z distance for finding the Vacuum/Flow contact signal. The search fails if no signal is detected within this distance.

data.name: calibration.tip.t043
data.value: Distance PickerZ retreats after Flow ON and before fine searching again. Used to remove residual vacuum/air.

data.name: calibration.tip.t044
data.value: Legacy compatibility value. Currently saved with the same value as Die Thickness.

data.name: calibration.tip.t045
data.value: Wait after turning Vacuum ON for the Flow signal to stabilize before searching.

data.name: calibration.tip.t046
data.value: Wait after turning Vacuum ON again following BackOff/Blow, before confirming Flow OFF.

data.name: calibration.tip.t047
data.value: Short Blow ON pulse after BackOff and Vacuum OFF to remove residual vacuum/air.

data.name: calibration.tip.t048
data.value: Wait for pressure to settle after Blow OFF before turning Vacuum ON again.

data.name: calibration.tip.t049
data.value: Maximum time to confirm Flow OFF after BackOff/Blow/Vacuum ON.

data.name: calibration.tip.t050
data.value: Flow contact must remain active for this duration to count as contact.

data.name: calibration.tip.t051
data.value: Interval between Flow-signal checks during contact searching.

data.name: calibration.tip.t052
data.value: Number of fine Flow searches. The maximum-minus-minimum result must be within Repeat Tolerance.

data.name: calibration.tip.t053
data.value: Maximum allowed deviation between repeated fine Flow detections.

data.name: calibration.tip.t054
data.value: Whether to return Picker Z to Avoid after calibration completes or fails.

data.name: calibration.tip.t055
data.value: Whether to fail immediately for an invalid initial state when Flow is already ON before searching.

data.name: calibration.tip.t056
data.value: PickUpZ preparation speed for safe-position and scan-start moves. Flow searches use the separate Search speed settings.

data.name: calibration.tip.t057
data.value: PickUpZ preparation acceleration. Flow searches use separate Search acceleration settings.

data.name: calibration.tip.t058
data.value: PickUpZ preparation deceleration. Flow searches use separate Search deceleration settings.

data.name: calibration.tip.t059
data.value: Absolute Z position where PickerZ starts Flow searching. After safe-position alignment, the selected PickerZ first moves here.

data.name: calibration.tip.t060
data.value: Die thickness. Saved Pick Z = Flow Z + Die Thickness + Film Thickness.

data.name: calibration.tip.t061
data.value: Wafer film thickness. Saved Pick Z = Flow Z + Die Thickness + Film Thickness.

data.name: calibration.tip.t062
data.value: Additional X correction from the Process reference for PickUp Z Cal. Added to the InputVisionX reference in the automatic pickup calculation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t063
data.value: Additional Y correction from the Process reference for PickUp Z Cal. Added to the InputStageY reference in the automatic pickup calculation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t064
data.value: Start searching this distance above the current Pick position, leaving clearance to avoid immediate contact with the film.

data.name: calibration.tip.t065
data.value: Distance to move back after Flow ON before Vacuum OFF and Blow pulse.

data.name: calibration.tip.t066
data.value: Correction added to or subtracted from the detected contact position when saving final Pick Z. Used to compensate for film compression.

data.name: calibration.tip.t067
data.value: Delay after Vacuum ON again before Flow OFF confirmation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t068
data.value: Short Blow ON time after BackOff and Vacuum OFF.

data.name: calibration.tip.t069
data.value: Settle delay after Blow OFF before Vacuum ON again.

data.name: calibration.tip.t070
data.value: Timeout to confirm Flow OFF after BackOff/Blow/Vacuum ON.

data.name: calibration.tip.t071
data.value: Fine search repeat count. Max-min result must be within Repeat Tolerance.

data.name: calibration.tip.t072
data.value: Allowed max-min difference between fine Flow detections.

data.name: calibration.tip.t073
data.value: Dedicated speed for moving StageY, NeedleX, NeedleZ and EjectPinZ to teaching/search positions during needle Z calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t074
data.value: Dedicated needle Z calibration acceleration. Avoid excessive values to reduce contact-search impact.

data.name: calibration.tip.t075
data.value: Dedicated needle Z calibration deceleration. Affects stopping stability after contact detection.

data.name: calibration.tip.t076
data.value: Maximum time to wait for InPosition after each movement command. Exceeding it fails calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t077
data.value: StageY position of WaferStageTouchSensor. The Y reference used when NeedleX moves above the sensor.

data.name: calibration.tip.t078
data.value: NeedleX position aligned over WaferStageTouchSensor. Reference for MOVE TOUCH and Cap/Pin contact searches.

data.name: calibration.tip.t079
data.value: EjectPinZ search-start reference used as NeedleCap. USE CURRENT applies the current EjectPinZ position.

data.name: calibration.tip.t080
data.value: NeedlePinZ search-start reference. NeedleZ moves here before searching for the NeedlePin/NeedleCap flush position.

data.name: calibration.tip.t081
data.value: Clearance from the saved NeedleCapTouchPosition when approaching contact. Places the cap near contact before pin searching.

data.name: calibration.tip.t082
data.value: Distance below NeedlePinFlushPosition. Final NeedlePinReadyPosition is this distance farther from Flush in the NeedlePin contact-search direction.

data.name: calibration.tip.t083
data.value: Maximum distance to lower NeedleCap in 100um steps to find the touch sensor. Fails immediately if not detected.

data.name: calibration.tip.t084
data.value: Maximum 10um-step NeedleCap re-search distance from the BackOff position after the 100um search.

data.name: calibration.tip.t085
data.value: Maximum 1um-step fine NeedleCap search distance from the BackOff position after the 10um search.

data.name: calibration.tip.t086
data.value: Maximum 10um-step NeedlePin search distance for finding the NeedlePinZ/NeedleCap flush position.

data.name: calibration.tip.t087
data.value: Maximum 1um-step fine search distance from the BackOff position after the NeedlePin 10um search.

data.name: calibration.tip.t088
data.value: The touch sensor must remain ON for this duration to count as contact.

data.name: calibration.tip.t089
data.value: Interval between touch-sensor checks during contact searching.

data.name: calibration.tip.t090
data.value: Whether to return NeedleZ/EjectPinZ to Avoid after calibration completes or fails.

data.name: calibration.tip.t091
data.value: Needle Pin Calibration Finder name requested from the Vision PC. Must match the registered Target name.

data.name: calibration.tip.t092
data.value: Time to wait for the Vision PC Needle Pin Calibration response. Exceeding it fails the sequence.

data.name: calibration.tip.t093
data.value: Dedicated StageY, VisionX, NeedleX/Z and EjectPinZ movement speed for needle pin calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t094
data.value: Dedicated needle pin calibration movement acceleration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t095
data.value: Dedicated needle pin calibration movement deceleration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t096
data.value: Maximum time to wait for InPosition after each axis movement command.

data.name: calibration.tip.t097
data.value: Camera X-axis calibration imaging position used for Needle Pin detection.

data.name: calibration.tip.t098
data.value: StageY process/imaging reference position for needle pin calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t099
data.value: NeedleX reference position aligned with the Vision field of view during needle pin calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t100
data.value: NeedleZ imaging/detection height reference for needle pin calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t101
data.value: EjectPinZ imaging/detection height reference for needle pin calibration.

data.name: calibration.tip.t102
data.value: Picker Z-axis speed while pressing the collet for cleaning. Higher values descend faster and increase impact. Start by verifying at a low value.

data.name: calibration.tip.t103
data.value: Z-axis acceleration during pressing. Together with speed, affects contact impact.

data.name: calibration.tip.t104
data.value: Z-axis deceleration during pressing. Affects deceleration just before contact.

data.name: calibration.tip.t105
data.value: User contact-Z correction. Sign convention: positive raises Z (less pressing); negative lowers Z (more pressing). Contact Z = Place teaching Z - die height - rim height - film height + this offset

data.name: calibration.tip.t106
data.value: Overpressure protection limit. Maximum additional depth (positive) below the calculated contact Z. Execution is blocked when a negative Contact Z Offset exceeds this limit.

data.name: calibration.tip.t107
data.value: Time to hold pressure after reaching contact Z.

data.name: calibration.tip.t108
data.value: Number of press-and-release repetitions for each collet.

data.name: calibration.tip.t109
data.value: Positive lift height between repeated presses. Rise to contact Z + this value, then descend again.

data.name: calibration.tip.t110
data.value: Maximum time to wait for axis movement completion. Exceeding it stops with an alarm.

data.name: calibration.tip.t111
data.value: Die height included in Place teaching Z. Teaching Z is raised by this height, so it is subtracted when calculating cleaning contact Z.

data.name: calibration.tip.t112
data.value: Rim height included in Place teaching Z. Subtracted in the contact-Z calculation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t113
data.value: Film height included in Place teaching Z. Subtracted in the contact-Z calculation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t114
data.value: Maximum clean-then-inspect retries after an NG collet inspection. If still NG after all retries, a collet replacement alarm is raised.

data.name: calibration.tip.t115
data.value: Whether production NG dies may be placed in NG map cells used for cleaning. True: allow continued use. False: exclude the cell from placement targets.

data.name: calibration.tip.t116
data.value: Whether to exclude only the affected picker from production after a collet replacement alarm, and continue with the remaining pickers.

data.name: calibration.tip.t117
data.value: Whether to trigger collet cleaning by GOOD Stage empty-bin loading count during automatic operation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t118
data.value: GOOD empty-bin loading trigger interval. Clean collets every n loads.

data.name: calibration.tip.t119
data.value: Whether to trigger collet cleaning by processed quantity during automatic operation.

data.name: calibration.tip.t120
data.value: Process-count trigger interval. Execute every n units of the Process Unit selected below.

data.name: calibration.tip.t121
data.value: Counting unit for the process-count trigger. Die: die count. Wafer: wafer count.

data.name: calibration.tip.t122
data.value: Whether to clean collets once when Auto operation starts (after Ready and before the first Pick).
